_comment: Shared cases for the stored icon rule. Python (notifications.normalize_icon) is the authority; TypeScript (utils.normalizeIcon) keeps the panel from writing a value that the store would only throw away. A value that is not text is never an icon. The ends are stripped of the characters that Python's str.strip removes, which is a different set from what JavaScript's trim removes.

cases.name: a plain icon is kept
a name with a hyphen and digits is kept
case and outer spaces are folded
a tab and a newline at the ends are stripped
a no-break space at the start is stripped
an information separator is whitespace in Python
a next-line character is whitespace in Python
a byte order mark is not whitespace in Python
a prefix with no name is empty
a name with no prefix is empty
another icon set is empty
a space inside the name is empty
a quote inside the name is empty
a second colon is empty
an underscore is empty
a letter outside ASCII is empty
the Kelvin sign folds to an ASCII k
an empty string is empty
only spaces is empty
null is empty
a number is empty
a boolean is empty
a list that holds an icon is empty
an object is empty
